groups.title: Database operations
groups.covers: insert, update, delete, upsert and partial success
groups.summary: Savepoints and Database.merge are not supported. Database.query is. Everything else behaves as the org does.

groups.title: Async jobs
groups.summary: Jobs run inline as soon as the transaction commits, instead of being queued for later.
differences: drained inline after commit, not truly deferred; per-chunk transactions and Database.Stateful are not modelled

groups.title: HTTP callouts
groups.summary: Callouts return whatever you register with POST /__emulator__/callouts. Nothing reaches the network, and a callout with no matching mock throws System.CalloutException rather than opening a socket.
differences: answered from the mock registry you arm with POST /__emulator__/callouts; unmatched callouts throw System.CalloutException, and nothing reaches the network

groups.title: Schema and describe
groups.summary: Describe answers only for the objects and fields you retrieved — it refuses rather than guessing. Permission checks always answer yes, because we do not model users.
differences: schema: describe labels derived where the metadata carries none; DisplayType modeled as its enum name; == identity on describe results Provisional (SCHEMA-DESIGN §7)
not supported: describe answers the retrieved metadata does not carry
not supported: describe for an object no metadata was retrieved for
answers as a system-mode user; field-level security is not enforced
not supported: describe surfaces outside the shipped set

groups.title: Custom Settings and Metadata
groups.summary: Org-default values only. Per-user and per-profile overrides are not modelled.
differences: org defaults only — no per-user or per-profile resolution

groups.title: Events and email
groups.summary: Events and emails are captured so you can assert on them, and never actually sent.
differences: captured and readable afterwards, never actually sent

groups.title: Crypto
groups.summary: Random numbers are seeded so your tests repeat. Hashing, signatures and encryption are not supported.
differences: seeded and reproducible rather than real entropy, which is the property tests need

conformance.denominator: 75 tests in the public fidelic-conformance suite that can run against a stock emulator; 5 skipped for an org prerequisite and 3 pending real-org verification are excluded from both sides of the fraction

tests.denominator: ALL 7518 @isTest methods in 793 test classes across five pinned open-source Salesforce codebases (apex-recipes, dlrs, EDA, fflib sample code, NPSP). Not the methods we admitted — the whole suite, including everything refused.

coverage.denominator: ALL 177 trigger-context pairs declared by the 26 triggers in this corpus. This is NOT the runtime ladder's denominator, which counts only the pairs declared by classified-EXECUTE triggers and is therefore a smaller number over a different population.
